result.reason: The operative language does not reach the playbook position. Although it provides a 12-month software conformance warranty and adds a professional-and-workmanlike services warranty with re-performance or refund, it provides no 90-day services warranty period, potentially creating an unnecessarily open-ended obligation. It also omits compliance with laws, limits the malicious-code warranty to willfully introduced code, and makes software correction subject only to commercially reasonable efforts, with refund available only if the agreement is terminated and only for prepaid fees. The margin comment and offered fallback do not cure these operative deficiencies. Unrelated Year 2000 terms are preserved, and the added language is generally clear, but the substantive omissions and overbroad services duration prevent approval.
